notes: This experiment changes only the HMM input representation.
The control uses archived raw z embeddings.
The treatment subtracts each bearing's own first-15-embedding mean.
No bearing-specific scale normalization is applied.
The AutoEncoder, training split, HMM structure, HMM hyperparameters and scoring interval are unchanged.
All bearings were inspected previously, so this is an exploratory ablation and not a blind test.
